verdict.rationale: Databricks documents Databricks Sandbox, an isolated environment where agents run the code they write, and Free Edition provides a separate no-cost workspace for experimenting. This is real sandbox isolation, not just a dry-run, but the docs do not say the sandbox keeps work away from production tables. Agents are documented as working directly with Unity Catalog tables, so data separation is unproven. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that sandbox execution is isolated from production data, dev/test data environments or cloning for safe testing, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: Agents run the code they write in Databricks Sandbox, an isolated environment whose home directory persists across sessions.
Databricks Free Edition is a no-cost version of Databricks designed for students, educators, hobbyists, and anyone interested in learning or experimenting with data and AI.
